method: Read original public full lesson learner tasks, public teacher activity narrative and preparation goals. Compare source task semantics and mathematical constraints to Edulytiks-owned Grade 6 candidate examples.

sourceActivities: 10-by-4-by-3 box tiling with one-, two-, and half-inch cubes
One-third-inch cubes and two alternative cube sizes packing 1 1/2-inch cube
Fish tank 10 by 8 1/4 by 6 feet with 4/5 full and 330 cubic-foot water levels
Baking pans compare capacity versus one-inch oven expansion clearance
originalMediaAndResearchGaps: A 2-inch cube cannot perfectly tile the 3-inch dimension
Source aquarium photo and cube manipulatives unverified

criteria: Model with correct labels/units and clear assumptions
Verify mathematical area, capacity, count and/or operation independently
Explain one or more alternate methods and reject invalid assumptions
Document actual student construction or defend open-ended decision
